environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed in a Kubernetes pod with an init container that executes pivot_root(2) into an overlayfs mount at /srv/jail before the JVM starts. The jail's root filesystem is assembled from a distroless base image (gcr.io/distroless/java17-debian11) with only the JRE and application JAR present. The container spec sets securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true with an emptyDir volume mounted at /srv/workspace for runtime data. The pod runs with a custom seccomp profile (runtime/default augmented with explicit deny of mount, pivot_root, ptrace, and process_vm_readv syscalls). There is no /etc/shadow, no /root directory, no AWS credential files, and /proc is mounted with hidepid=2. The container's /bin/sh is a busybox static binary with only 'echo' and 'true' appended to PATH - all other commands (cat, ls, df, free, ps) are absent from the filesystem. ADMIN_TOKEN is injected via a Kubernetes Secret with projected volume (not environment variable), but the code falls back to 'changeme' since ADMIN_TOKEN env var is unset in this deployment.

config.runtime: JVM 17 in distroless container with pivot_root jail
config.network_policy: egress allowed only to port 443 of internal service mesh
